description.value:
A forearm that ends in a muscular spray-nozzle gland. Ranged Strike: 15-foot cone, 2d4 acid, basic Reflex against your class DC (or DC 14 + half level), usable again after 1d4 rounds.

Rider: It seeps under stress. In a tense scene the GM may call a DC 5 flat check or you scorch a surface, a document, or a handshake you didn't mean to.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability is a new 15-foot cone attack with its own save DC and a 1d4-round recharge -- an AoE ability with a save is a spell-like granted Action, not something the Strike rule element (single-target attacks only) can produce; same class of gap as the equipment pass's ammo cards.
